lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the pectoral fin. These columns form a repeating spatial pattern with approximately 4-6 primary nodes per vertical axis along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the high-luminance spots act as nodes at the intersection of vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One distinct longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, running horizontally from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle, marked by a sharp highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance spots, primarily located on the distal half of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral and pelvic regions of the shark's silhouette.
